about_the_game:
[GGST Season Pass 4 Content]

An exciting season pass that includes 4 additional playable characters, stages and season 4 pass bonus character colors as additional DLC for the Guilty Gear -Strive- game.

*Be aware that GGST Season Pass 4 can be purchased as a bundle or on its own. Please be careful to ensure you do not make a duplicate purchase.

[GGST Season Pass 4 Content]

・DLC Season 4 Characters Additional Colors (Available Starting October 31 2024)

・DLC character #14 Queen Dizzy (Available October 31 2024)

・DLC character #15 Venom (Available March 24 2025)

・DLC character #16 Unika (Available Spring 2025)

・DLC character #17 Lucy (Cyberpunk: Edgerunners) (Available Summer 2025) 

・DLC stage #7 (Available Spring 2025)

・DLC stage #8 (Available Summer 2025)

・[Season Pass 4 Purchase Bonus] Season Pass 4 Premium Color (Color for 28 characters available on release, colors for 3 future additional characters will be added along with the characters)

*Purchasing the main product is required to access this content. You will also need to have downloaded the latest updates.
